packageRules.description: docker-compose.yml, docker-compose-local.yml and ci.yml pin the same Postgres image, and the Kubernetes deployment mirrors it (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): bump all three in one PR so they cannot drift.
A Postgres major bump needs a dump and restore of the data directory, so it never rides along with the group above: it gets its own PR, and only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
